{{Quote|You've done too much in your life to have those kinds of regrets. The Jedi are guardians and protectors of the galaxy, but these past fifty years we've needed so much more. The Republic had to rebuild. We needed leaders to unite us, to help us work together. You saw that need, and you filled it."<br />"You sound like my campaign manager. '''Vaner Shan''' was the son of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Bastila Shan]], two famous [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and heroes of the [[Jedi Civil War]] that was fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Born around [[3954 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male's]] name was an anagram of his father's, but unlike both his [[Parent/Legends|parents]], Vaner was not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and therefore never joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

Vaner became a [[Politics/Legends|politician]] instead, developing into a major leader in the time of rebuilding following the Jedi Civil War, and he was a candidate to run for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] in [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]]. By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he had [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a woman named [[Emess Shan|Emess]] and had two children named [[Reesa Shan|Reesa]] and [[Bress Shan]]. In 3900 BBY, Vaner and his family visited his mother on the anniversary of her marriage to Revan, who had disappeared before Vaner had been born.<ref name="Revan" />

Vaner's situation of not being born Force-sensitive despite being the son of a powerful [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] was repeated generations later with his descendant, [[Theron Shan]].

==Personality and traits==
Vaner greatly resembled his father at the time of the Jedi Civil War, having Revan's dark [[Color/Legends|brown]] eyes, fair skin and shoulder length dark brown hair.
